title: JAMS model component libraries
description:
Model component libraries for the JAMS framework (J2000 model family and related models). The libraries are used with the JAMS framework and its model editor JUICE.


Authors of the model component libraries

  • J2K_base: Peter Krause, Christian Fischer, Sven Kralisch, Annika Künne, Andrew Watson, Santosh Nepal (contributors: Manfred Fink, Heiko Busch, Holm Kipka, Corina Manusch)
  • J2K_ext: Christian Fischer, Christin Michel, Peter Krause, Manfred Fink, Sven Kralisch, Holm Kipka, Heiko Busch, Santosh Nepal, Carsten Busch, Bjoern Pfennig, Daniel Varga (contributors: Sophie Biskop)
  • J2K_iso: Andrew Watson, Sven Kralisch, Christian Birkel
  • J2K_highres: Manfred Fink (contributors: Sven Kralisch)
  • J2K_Africa: Andrew Watson (contributors: Sven Kralisch)
  • J2K_Himalaya: Santosh Nepal, Manfred Fink, Peter Krause (contributors: Sven Kralisch, Christian Fischer)
  • J2K_Irstea: Mériem Labbas, Flora Branger, François Tilmant, Isabelle Gouttevin, Sven Kralisch, Jordi Bolibar, Jérémie Bonneau, Louise Mimeau, Marko Adamovic, Thomas Cipriani (contributors: Maxime Turko, Nico Hachgenei, Louise Crochemore, Michael Rabotin)
  • J2K_Irstea_dev: Nico Hachgenei, Nathan Pellerin, Anne-Lou Borgna, Louise Crochemore, Flora Branger, Jérémie Bonneau, Olivier Champagne, François Tilmant, Olivier Grandjouan, Vincent Thiercelin (contributors: Michael Rabotin)
  • J2K_SASSCAL: Sven Kralisch, Markus Meinhardt (contributors: Andrew Watson)
  • J2K_S_N: Manfred Fink, Ulrike Bende-Michl, Sven Kralisch, Holm Kipka, Christian Fischer, Bjoern Pfennig, Annika Künne, Peter Krause, Hendrik Göhmann (contributors: Marcel Wetzel, François Tilmant)
  • J2Kg: Peter Krause, Christian Fischer, Manfred Fink, Sven Kralisch
  • DRYvER: Annika Künne, Sven Kralisch, Peter Krause
  • Thornthwaite: Sven Kralisch, Manfred Fink
